editorial.name: Ira Design
editorial.descriptionZh: IRA Design是Creative Tim的手绘风插画库，提供人物、物体、背景及渐变配色入口。官方资产仓库按MIT许可免费提供插画，PNG与SVG下载链接见原README，使用时须保留版权和许可通知。
editorial.descriptionEn: IRA Design by Creative Tim provides hand-drawn characters, objects and backgrounds, with gradient controls on its website. Its official illustration assets are free under the MIT license. The original asset README links PNG and SVG packages. Copyright and permission notices must be retained; the asset license does not establish a license for every website file.
editorial.takeawayZh: 按人物、物体和背景挑选手绘风插画
editorial.noteZh: 我们在首页看到人物场景、部件渐变选项及Colored、Outline入口。背景页露出星空、沙发房间和车站三种预览，下缘有裁切；人物页展示三种紫衣人物姿态。图片只证明当前已呈现的素材，未实测换色或下载。资产仓库README列PNG、SVG包，MIT要求保留版权和许可；课程广告、其他付费产品及整站程序许可另算。

reasons.statement: 本Entry是IRA Design插画资产库。Backgrounds实际展示星空、室内家具和车站等背景；Characters另展示人物姿态，按visual-assets/illustrations-vectors归类，不把前端实现技术作为主类。
